verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud ships a first-party, per-project MCP server that automatically exposes project data to AI interfaces like ChatGPT and Cursor, confirmed both in docs and by a live probe of the documented endpoint. This directly satisfies the agent-as-tool-caller story for query/data operations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation enumerating distinct analytics or index-management operations exposed via the MCP tool surface (docs mostly emphasize query/interaction, not analytics/index-ops granularity) and independent third-party confirmation beyond vendor docs/probe.
